Bhayangkara vs Persijap: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of a crucial match in the relegation battle of the Indonesian Super League. At the Wibawa Mukti Stadium, Bhayangkara hosts its direct competitor, Persijap Jepara. This is a battle between two struggling sides occupying the bottom spots of the table, and the outcome of this encounter could be decisive in their fight to stay in the top flight.

Kick-off: October 27, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK)
Stadium: Wibawa Mukti Stadium, Cikarang
Competition: Indonesia Super League

Bhayangkara vs Persijap: Match Preview

This is a classic 'six-pointer' between the 18th and 17th placed teams in the league. Bhayangkara comes into the game winless this season and at the bottom of the table. Persijap, a newcomer to the elite division, is also in the relegation zone and has shown very poor results, especially in away matches. Encounters between these teams are always hard-fought, and the upcoming game should be no exception.

Team Form and Analysis

Bhayangkara

'The Guardians' are having a disastrous season. The team is the worst in the league in terms of both goals scored and goals conceded. Bhayangkara has suffered several defeats in recent matches, which has only worsened their situation. The only advantage for the hosts is their home field, where they will try to earn their first points of the season against a direct competitor.

Persijap Jepara

League newcomer Persijap has expectedly faced difficulties at a higher level. The team is in the relegation zone and is one of the lowest-scoring in the championship. The 'Kalinyamat Warriors' have lost most of their away games and rarely keep a clean sheet. Their main task will be to play as solidly as possible in defense and try to catch their chance on the counter-attack.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Bhayangkara (4-3-3): Setiawan; Putu Gede, Herrera, Aryanto, Fatchu Rochman; Mier, Hargianto, Setyo; Ragil, Brandão, Ripoll.
  • Persijap (4-2-3-1): Risky; Gunawan, Rizky, Akbar, Ardian; Basori, Anwar; Raihanov, Renan, Khushnood; Kamil.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

In a battle of underdogs, it is difficult to single out a clear favorite, but Bhayangkara has the advantage of playing at home. A tense game with a lot of mücadele and a minimum of scoring chances is expected.

  • Main Prediction: Bhayangkara Double Chance (1X). In such an important home match, 'The Guardians' should secure at least one point.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Both teams have huge problems in attack, and the stakes in this match will be extremely high.

Persib Bandung vs Persis Solo: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the most anticipated matches of the Indonesian Super League round, as Persib Bandung hosts Persis Solo at their home ground. This is a confrontation between two ambitious teams with large fanbases, both fighting for the top spots in the league table.

Kick-off: October 27, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK)
Stadium: Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium, Bandung
Competition: Indonesia Super League

Persib vs Persis Solo: Match Preview

Persib Bandung, one of the giants of Indonesian football, comes into the match as the favorite, especially considering their home-field advantage where the team is traditionally strong. Persis Solo, in turn, has established itself as a very tough opponent, capable of challenging any leader. The team is unbeaten in their last four matches. The head-to-head history favors Persib: the 'Tigers' have won three of the last four encounters, with the other match ending in a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Persib Bandung

The 'Blue Princes' are in the leading group and are aiming to catch up with the league leaders. Bojan Hodak's team plays powerful attacking football, boasting one of the best forward lines in the league, featuring stars like David da Silva and Ciro Alves. In the last round, Persib secured a convincing victory, which should boost the team's confidence ahead of this important match.

Persis Solo

The 'Sambernyawa Warriors' are a solid mid-table team aiming for a top-half finish this season. The team shows a good balance between defense and attack, and their unbeaten streak is a testament to their excellent current form. Persis Solo will aim to take points from a formidable opponent on the road, relying on organized defense and quick counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Persib Bandung (4-3-3): Mendoza; Henhen, Kuipers, Rodríguez, Rezaldi; Klok, Kusnandar, Ryan; Febrian, da Silva, Ciro.
  • Persis Solo (4-2-3-1): Pandey; Gafur, Bardanca, Mena, Bustos; Sidibé, Taha; Fernandinho, Rodríguez, Moussa; Sananta.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A tense and entertaining match is expected. Persib will likely dominate due to their class and home support, but Persis Solo is in excellent form and capable of causing problems for the hosts.

  • Main Prediction: Persib Bandung to Win. Despite the visitors' good form, Persib is too strong at home and has historically dominated this fixture.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both Teams to Score. Both teams have quality attacking players, and the last head-to-head meeting ended in a high-scoring 2-2 draw.

Surkhon vs Andijan: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Uzbekistan Super League match, where Surkhon Termez hosts Andijan. This is a clash between two neighbors from the bottom half of the league table, both looking to secure important points to distance themselves from the relegation battle.

Kick-off: October 27, 2025, 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK)
Stadium: Surkhon Stadium, Termez
Competition: Uzbekistan Super League

Surkhon vs Andijan: Match Preview

Surkhon comes into this match in 12th place with 25 points. Andijan is positioned slightly higher in 10th place, with 28 points from 24 games. This is a contest between two evenly matched teams, a fact supported by their head-to-head history: in 14 previous meetings, Surkhon has won 6 times, Andijan 5 times, with 3 matches ending in a draw. The first-round encounter this season ended with a 2-1 victory for Surkhon.

Team Form and Analysis

Surkhon

The team from Termez has been highly inconsistent. Surkhon's main problem is their attack - they are one of the lowest-scoring teams in the league, with only 19 goals in 25 matches. Most of Surkhon's recent games have been low-scoring: 8 of their last 10 Superliga matches have had under 2.5 goals. In the last round, the team lost 1-2 to Sogdiana.

Andijan

Andijan also lacks consistency but approaches the match in better spirits after a high-scoring 4-3 victory over Shortan in the last round. The team scores significantly more than their opponent (32 goals) but also has one of the worst defensive records in the league (39 goals conceded). Andijan will look to leverage their attacking strengths against the low-scoring Surkhon.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Surkhon (5-4-1): Yusupov; Askarov, Puškaric, Khafizov, Saidov, Alikulov; Stanojevic, Abdumannonov, Nabiev, Asrorov; Abdukholikov.
  • Andijan (4-3-3): Almazov; Mamatkazin, Ortikboev, Ismailov, Bekmuratov; Abdurashidov, Azamov, Gulyamov; Mamadrakhimov, Kosmynin, Abdumajidov.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A tight battle between two evenly matched teams is expected, where small details could decide the outcome. Surkhon is playing at home and will try to impose their tactical, low-scoring style, while Andijan will attempt to be more aggressive in attack.

  • Main Prediction: Andijan Double Chance (X2). The visitors are in slightly better form and have a more potent attack, which should help them to at least avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Surkhon is an extremely low-scoring team, and despite Andijan's recent high-scoring game, a head-to-head match between table neighbors is unlikely to be rich in goals.

Akhmat Grozny vs Sochi: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Russian Premier League Matchday 13 fixture, as Akhmat Grozny hosts FC Sochi at the Akhmat Arena. This is a clash between two teams from the bottom half of the table, for whom every point is crucial in the relegation battle.

Kick-off: October 27, 2025, 16:30 UTC (19:30 MSK)
Stadium: Akhmat Arena, Grozny
Competition: Russian Premier League, Matchday 13

Akhmat Grozny vs Sochi: Match Preview

Akhmat comes into the match in 9th place, showing mixed results. However, the Grozny side is traditionally strong at home and has secured three victories in home games this season. Sochi, on the other hand, is in a deep crisis, sitting at the bottom of the table in 16th place. The team is in the relegation zone, showing very poor form (only an 8% win rate this season) and performing extremely poorly away from home. The head-to-head history favors Sochi, who have won 6 of the last 10 encounters, but the last three meetings in Grozny have all ended in a 1-0 victory for Akhmat.

Team Form and Analysis

Akhmat Grozny

After a series of setbacks at the start of the season, the team from Grozny has managed to stabilize its play. Akhmat relies on a solid defense and quick counter-attacks, especially in home matches. The team will be looking to capitalize on their opponent's terrible form to secure a vital three points and solidify their mid-table position.

Sochi

Sochi is having a disastrous season. The team averages just 0.58 goals per game while conceding 2.33, which is one of the worst records in the league. The 'Leopards' have yet to win on the road. The team's main problem is the lack of balance between the lines and poor finishing. It will be extremely difficult for the visitors to expect a positive result against a motivated Akhmat side playing at home.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Akhmat (4-2-3-1): Shelia; Bogosavac, Ghandri, Semenov, Todorović; Timofeev, Oleynikov; Kovachev, Camilo, Berisha; Agalarov.
  • Sochi (5-4-1): Zabolotny; Makarchuk, Drkušić, Litvinov, Medrano, Zaika; Yusupov, Kravtsov, Burmistrov, Kramarić; Guarirapa.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Akhmat is the clear favorite in this confrontation. The home-field advantage, where the team is traditionally strong, and Sochi's deep crisis make a home win the most likely outcome.

  • Main Prediction: Akhmat Grozny to Win. The Grozny team should comfortably defeat the league's main underdog on their home turf.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Matches between these teams are rarely high-scoring (only 4 of the last 10 had over 2.5 goals), and Akhmat has won their recent home games against Sochi with a minimal scoreline.

Gaziantep FK vs Fenerbahçe: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Turkish Super Lig Matchday 10 fixture, as Gaziantep FK hosts the league leaders, Fenerbahçe, at the Kalyon Stadium. This is a clash between a team from the relegation zone and the main title contender, who is in impeccable form.

Kick-off: October 27, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK)
Stadium: Kalyon Stadium, Gaziantep
Competition: Turkish Super Lig, Matchday 10

Gaziantep FK vs Fenerbahçe: Match Preview

Fenerbahçe comes into the match as the undisputed favorite. The 'Yellow Canaries' top the league table, having not suffered a single defeat this season. Gaziantep, in contrast, is in 18th place in the relegation zone, having lost their last four matches in a row. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Istanbul giants: Fenerbahçe has won the last six consecutive encounters, scoring 17 goals in the process.

Team Form and Analysis

Gaziantep FK

The team from Gaziantep is having a disastrous season. Their main problem is a weak attack - the team has failed to score in their last three home matches. Furthermore, Gaziantep has one of the worst defensive records in the league. In a home match against the league leader, the team is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy in hopes of avoiding a heavy defeat.

Fenerbahçe

The Istanbul club is in excellent form, having won their last five away matches in the league. The team boasts a powerful squad, with stars like Edin Džeko and Dušan Tadić shining in attack. Fenerbahçe plays the most prolific football in the league and will be aiming for another convincing victory to strengthen their lead.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Gaziantep (5-4-1): Niță; Ersoy, Djilobodji, N'Koulou, Kızıldağ, Morais; Maxim, Jevtović, Marković, Gradel; Drăguș.
  • Fenerbahçe (4-2-3-1): Livaković; Osayi-Samuel, Becão, Djiku, Kadıoğlu; Yüksek, Fred; Kahveci, Szymański, Tadić; Džeko.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in class, current form, and player quality between the teams is colossal. Fenerbahçe should not face any difficulties in this match against one of the underdogs.

  • Main Prediction: Fenerbahçe to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The 'Canaries' are a class above and should win by a margin of at least two goals, as they have done in 5 of the last 6 head-to-head meetings.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Fenerbahçe has the best attack in the league, and 5 of the last 6 head-to-head matches have had over 2.5 goals.

Real Betis vs Atlético Madrid: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the final match of La Liga's 10th round, as Real Betis hosts Atlético Madrid. This is a clash between two teams from the leading group, sitting next to each other in the league table with 16 points each and fighting for a spot in the Champions League zone.

Kick-off: October 27, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK)
Stadium: Benito Villamarín, Seville
Competition: La Liga, Matchday 10

Real Betis vs Atlético Madrid: Match Preview

Betis comes into the match in good form, having lost only once this season. Manuel Pellegrini's side has won three of their last six games, but drew 2-2 with Villarreal in the last round. Atlético has almost identical stats, also winning three of their last six matches. In their previous game, 'Los Colchoneros' secured a minimal 1-0 victory over Osasuna. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Madrid club, with Atlético winning 28 of the last 47 matches and 7 of the last 10 encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Real Betis

The 'Green and Whites' are playing a high-scoring brand of football, averaging 1.6 goals per game in their last ten matches. The team enjoys a lot of possession and creates a fair number of chances. Five of Betis's last six La Liga games have seen over 2.5 goals. The attacking leader is Juan Hernandez, who has scored 4 goals.

Atlético Madrid

Diego Simeone's team, despite a recent European defeat, looks confident in the league. 'Los Rojiblancos' are highly prolific, averaging 2.0 goals per game in their last ten matches. However, Atlético has struggled on the road, drawing three of their last five away fixtures. In attack, Julián Álvarez stands out for Madrid with 6 goals to his name.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Real Betis (4-2-3-1): López; Bellerín, Bartra, Natan, Firpo; Amrabat, Fornals; Antony, Lo Celso, Ezzalzouli; Hernandez.
  • Atlético Madrid (4-4-2): Oblak; Llorente, Le Normand, Giménez, Hancko; Simeone, Koke, Barrios, González; Sørloth, Álvarez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A tight battle is expected between two evenly matched teams in good form. Betis is strong at home, while Atlético has the advantage in class and head-to-head encounters.

  • Main Prediction: Real Betis Double Chance (1X). The Sevillistas have lost only once this season and are capable of securing at least a draw at home against an Atlético side that is not always consistent on the road.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Betis plays a high-scoring style, and Atlético possesses a powerful attack, which suggests an exchange of goals is likely.
